meta.description: Joe's Italian Kitchen — Almonte, Wellington West, and Preston Street. Pinsa, pasta, OpenTable. info@joesitaliankitchen.ca

callbar.line: Reservations are on OpenTable — we do not book tables on this preview.
callbar.short: OpenTable for tables — not this preview.

home.title: Where exceptional flavours meets a warm and inviting atmosphere.
home.lead: Old-world tradition with new-world cooking, as they write it. Three open rooms. Canada’s first certified Pinsaria, on their home page.
home.heroAlt: A Joe's pinsa with tomatoes and basil.
home.roomsLead: Three open rooms. Reservations are on OpenTable for each one — this preview does not take tables.
home.pinsaLead: They write: a blend of sourdough, rice, soy and wheat flour, imported from Rome. Caputo 00, DiMarco Pinsa flour, San Marzano DOP tomatoes.
home.menuLead: Dishes as printed. No invented prices — their dine-in HTML does not list dollars.

locationsPage.title: Locations
locationsPage.lead: Almonte, Wellington West, and Preston Street. Camelot Drive still has a page — it prints CLOSED.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Shared dishes from their Almonte, Wellington, and Preston dine-in pages. Builds differ slightly by room. We do not invent prices.
menu.note: Full live boards stay on joesitaliankitchen.ca. Allergies: ask the kitchen.

hours.title: Hours
hours.lead: As printed on each location page. A few weekday lines on the live site are blank or doubled — we note that.
hours.reserve: Reserve on OpenTable for that room. This preview does not take tables.

about.title: About
about.lead: Weaving old world traditions with new world creativity. Their goal is a diverse menu that preserves and elevates hearty dishes — the true essence of Italian cuisine, as they write it.
about.pinsa: Canada’s first certified Pinsaria, on their home page.
about.camelot: Joe's Pinsa & Panini at 60 Camelot Drive, Nepean, still has a page. It prints CLOSED.
about.photoAlt: Patio at the Almonte mill — Joe’s sign, Cinzano umbrellas, the river beyond.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: info@joesitaliankitchen.ca is on every page. Almonte also prints almonte@joesitaliankitchen.ca. Reservations are OpenTable for each room — not a form here.
contact.emailNote: This preview does not take bookings by email. Use OpenTable, or call the room.

gifts.title: Gift cards
gifts.lead: Wellington and Almonte gift cards are on Toast, as their footer prints. We did not find a Preston gift-card button.
gifts.preston: No Preston gift-card link on their live site.

loc.orderNote: Almonte and Wellington share one Mobi2go order link on their nav. Preston has no Order Online item in that menu.

footer.copy: Preview of joesitaliankitchen.ca. Live WordPress stays until they say otherwise. French is a courtesy toggle — their site is English.
